name: DepthSplat
definition: A method connecting Gaussian splatting and depth estimation by leveraging pre-trained monocular depth features to augment multi-view feature matching, enabling robust multi-view depth prediction and feed-forward 3D Gaussian splatting reconstruction.
summary: DepthSplat is a feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting method that concatenates monocular features with multi-view cost volumes early in the pipeline to produce robust depth maps and Gaussian parameters.
